questions.question: Explain how a two-dimensional array is represented in memory. Write a C program to multiply two matrices.
questions.solution_html:
• A two-dimensional array is stored in memory as a contiguous block of sequential memory
  • locations, even though it is conceptually viewed as a table with rows and columns.
  • Memory Representation(6 marks)
  • There are two primary methods for organizing these elements in linear memory
  • Row-Major Order: Elements are stored row by row. All elements of the first row are placed
  • first, followed by all elements of the second row, and so on. This is the standard method used
  • in C and C++.
  • Column-Major Order: Elements are stored column by column. All elements of the first column
  • are placed first, then the second column, etc..
